use_case_name: Compare Two Files Byte by Byte

claims.content: The user compares two files byte by byte to identify exactly which bytes differ between them.

goal.raw_text: The user compares two files byte by byte to identify exactly which bytes differ between them.

claims.content: The PeaZip application is installed and running on an x-86 compatible CPU system.
The user has access to the file manager interface or archive browsing interface where files are visible.
At least two files exist on the system that can be selected for comparison.
The user selects a file and invokes the 'Compare selected file with...' command (shortcut '=') from the File tools menu.

trigger.raw_text: The user selects a file and invokes the 'Compare selected file with...' command (shortcut '=') from the File tools menu.

claims.content: The user selects a file in the PeaZip interface (file manager, archive browsing, or extraction window).
The user invokes the 'Compare selected file with...' command via the File tools menu or by pressing the '=' shortcut key.
The system performs a byte-to-byte comparison between the two selected files, identifying exactly which bytes differ.
The system has identified and displayed exactly which bytes differ between the two compared files.
